description: Full Vitest test suite covering all 7 test categories from roadmap §10 acceptance criteria. Plus final build validation, README, and database migration verification. Depends on FEAT-001 through FEAT-004 all being complete. This is the final FEAT.
steps: Write src/lib/__tests__/qr-generator.test.ts. Tests: (1) generateQR(url) without logo returns Buffer with length > 1000 (valid PNG). (2) generateQR(url, validLogoPath) with a real PNG logo file (create a 50x50 red square PNG in test fixtures using @napi-rs/canvas) returns a Buffer. (3) The no-logo QR buffer can be decoded using jsQR — import jsQR, convert buffer to ImageData, assert decoded.data === input URL. (4) When logo path is invalid/nonexistent, falls back gracefully and returns a valid QR buffer without logo. (5) The QR with logo can also be decoded (verifies error correction H is sufficient with 160x160 logo overlay on 800x800 QR). Create test fixture helper in src/test/fixtures/create-test-logo.ts that generates a minimal valid PNG buffer using @napi-rs/canvas.

Write src/lib/__tests__/signature-block-generator.test.ts. Mock issuance data: create a factory function buildMockIssuance() in src/test/fixtures/mock-issuance.ts returning a valid IssuanceWithRelations object. Tests: (1) generateSignatureBlock(mockIssuance, mockQrBuffer) returns a Buffer > 10000 bytes. (2) Use @napi-rs/canvas Image to verify output dimensions are 800x200. (3) Custom opts {width:1200, height:300} produces proportionally larger output. (4) mockIssuance with logoPath=null renders without error (no org logo in left column). (5) Doc title > 60 chars is truncated in output (can't easily check pixel content, but assert function doesn't throw).

Write src/lib/__tests__/issuance-state.test.ts. Import canTransition and assertTransition from src/lib/issuance-state-machine.ts. Tests: (1) canTransition('DRAFT','ISSUED') === true. (2) canTransition('DRAFT','REVOKED') === false. (3) canTransition('ISSUED','REVOKED') === true. (4) canTransition('ISSUED','EXPIRED') === true. (5) canTransition('REVOKED','ISSUED') === false. (6) canTransition('REVOKED','DRAFT') === false. (7) canTransition('EXPIRED','ISSUED') === false. (8) assertTransition('DRAFT','ISSUED') does not throw. (9) assertTransition('DRAFT','REVOKED') throws an Error with message containing 'Invalid transition'.

Write src/app/api/__tests__/issuances.test.ts. Mock src/lib/db.ts using vi.mock and vi.mocked. Mock src/lib/auth-utils.ts requireAdmin to simulate authenticated admin session. Tests: (1) POST /api/issuances with valid CreateIssuanceSchema payload returns 201 and body.data.ref has length >= 21. (2) POST /api/issuances with missing title returns 422 and body.error.code === 'VALIDATION_ERROR'. (3) POST /api/issuances with mocked requireAdmin throwing 401 returns 401. (4) POST /api/issuances/[id]/issue with DRAFT issuance: mock generateQR and generateSignatureBlock to return Buffer.alloc(100), mock fs.mkdirSync and fs.writeFile. Assert prisma.$transaction called, response 200, body.data.status === 'ISSUED'. (5) POST /api/issuances/[id]/issue with ISSUED issuance returns 409. (6) POST /api/issuances/[id]/revoke with reason 'Valid reason here' returns 200. (7) POST /api/issuances/[id]/revoke with reason 'short' (< 10 chars) returns 422.

Write src/app/api/__tests__/verify.test.ts. Mock src/lib/services/verification-service.ts. Tests: (1) GET /api/verify/{validRef} with mocked service returning PublicIssuanceData returns 200 with expected public fields. (2) Response body does NOT contain keys 'adminNotes', 'createdById', 'passwordHash', 'email'. (3) GET /api/verify/{unknownRef} with mocked service returning null returns 404. (4) GET /api/verify/{ref} with rate limiter returning false returns 429. (5) Status REVOKED in response includes status:'REVOKED'.

Write src/app/api/__tests__/auth.test.ts. Tests: (1) GET /api/issuances with no session (mock requireAdmin to throw 401) returns 401. (2) GET /api/verify/{ref} with no session still returns 200 (public endpoint, no auth required). (3) Rate limiter: create a RateLimiter instance in test, call check() 30 times from same IP — all return true. Call 31st time — returns false. (4) Rate limiter resets after window expires: mock Date.now() to advance past window, then check() returns true again.

Write src/app/api/__tests__/issuances-list.test.ts. Mock Prisma. Tests: (1) GET /api/issuances?search=TestDoc returns where clause including title contains 'TestDoc'. (2) GET /api/issuances?status=ISSUED returns where.status = 'ISSUED'. (3) GET /api/issuances?dateFrom=2024-01-01&dateTo=2024-12-31 builds correct date range filter. (4) GET /api/issuances?page=2&limit=10 calls findMany with skip:10, take:10. (5) GET /api/issuances?sort=oldest calls orderBy:{createdAt:'asc'}.

Write src/lib/__tests__/audit.test.ts. Mock Prisma auditEvent.create. Tests: (1) writeAuditEvent({action:'TEST', entityType:'Issuance', entityId:'id1'}) calls prisma.auditEvent.create with correct fields. (2) writeAuditEvent does not throw even if prisma.auditEvent.create rejects (vi.mocked(prisma.auditEvent.create).mockRejectedValue(new Error('DB error'))). (3) AuditEvent model in Prisma schema has no update() or delete() methods exposed in our audit.ts wrapper — assert that audit.ts only exports writeAuditEvent and has no updateAuditEvent or deleteAuditEvent exports.
Run the full test suite and fix any failures: `npm run test`. All tests must pass. Record actual pass/fail counts.
Run final build pipeline: `npm run build` (0 errors), `npm run typecheck` (0 errors), `npm run lint` (0 errors). Fix every error found.
Run `npx prisma migrate dev` on a clean database to verify migrations apply cleanly. Run `npx prisma db seed` to verify seed works.

Write README.md with these sections: (1) WSS QR Signature — 2-3 sentence project overview. (2) Prerequisites: Node.js 20+, npm 10+. (3) Quick Start: git clone, npm install, cp .env.example .env (fill vars), npx prisma migrate dev, npx prisma db seed, npm run dev → http://localhost:3000/admin (login: admin@example.com / password from seed). (4) Environment Variables: table with all 5 vars, description, and example value. (5) Available Scripts: npm run dev, npm run build, npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test, npm run test:coverage. (6) Database: npx prisma studio, npx prisma migrate dev --name <name>, npx prisma db seed. (7) Architecture: brief paragraph + link to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. (8) Security: brief paragraph + link to docs/SECURITY.md. (9) Design System: brief paragraph + link to docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md. (10) License: MIT.

Self-assess Anti-AI-Slop score across all implemented UI. Score each of the 10 dimensions honestly (0-5 each, max 50). Minimum acceptance: total >= 42, product specificity >= 4, functional completeness >= 4, accessibility >= 4. Record score and evidence in docs/DESIGN_DECISIONS.md under section 'Anti-AI-Slop Gate Results'. If score < 42, identify and fix the lowest-scoring dimensions before marking FEAT-005 complete.
acceptance_criteria: npm run test exits 0 with all test files passing
npx prisma migrate dev exits 0 on clean database
Anti-AI-Slop score >= 42/50 with evidence documented in docs/DESIGN_DECISIONS.md
